name: MD-05
label: Safe D

key_factors: Open seat after Hoyer's retirement, but Democratic nominee Boafo heavily funded
Prediction markets price Democratic win at ~97%
Republican Chaffee has minimal reported fundraising
model.rationale: The seat's D+17 partisan lean and the absence of any competitive polling or ratings pointing the other way make this a safe Democratic hold. Boafo's large war chest and outside support, plus markets pricing a Democratic win near certainty, reinforce the fundamentals.
model.watch: Any sign of a serious Republican-funded effort or unexpected polling showing a single-digit race would warrant a downgrade.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.
Open seat: Steny Hoyer (D) is not on the ballot.

overview:
Steny Hoyer's retirement opens this southern Maryland seat, but the district's D+17 partisan lean keeps it firmly in Democratic hands. Adrian Boafo enters the general election with strong fundraising and substantial outside support, while Republican Chris Chaffee has reported little financial activity. No public general-election polls are available, and no expert raters have flagged the race as competitive.

Prediction markets price a Democratic win at roughly 97%, consistent with the district's fundamentals. The forecast expects a comfortable Democratic margin in the low-to-mid twenties, with modest uncertainty given the lack of polling.
